title: Watching vector growth
description: You can use Tracker's printed constructors to follow a vector reallocation.

steps.description: Tracker prints default, copy and move construction. Its move constructor keeps the original id and sets the source id to -1; the destructor prints only nonnegative ids.
You reserve space for one Tracker and construct the first element in place. The output prints Tracker#0 default-ctor.

steps.question: Which constructor message follows Tracker#1 default-ctor in the supplied run?
steps.answer: Tracker#0 move-ctor follows it. Growing the vector relocates the first element through the supplied move constructor.

steps.description: You see a move message for Tracker#0 and no copy message. At the end of main, the output prints destructors for Tracker#0 and Tracker#1.
